selectionRule: Fixed finalists. Select a LOW-complexity model within 3% of the best development macro-player MAE that passes workload behavior tests. Holdout reports only; it cannot retune selection.
limitations: Every fifth eligible game is a deterministic chronological target.
ESPN history was retrieved retrospectively; this is not verified information-time evidence.
The baseline abstains more often, so its metrics have lower coverage and are not a perfect paired comparison.
